script.name: prologue
script.objective: Install the toolchains the example needs, check them and build the example when it is not built.

script.name: t1_gateway_bad_request
script.objective: [H1] Start gateway-rs, send a valid request, then an empty body, an oversized header and bad path values; after each, send the valid request again. FAIL if the process exits or restarts (pid and start time from /proc) or the valid request gets no answer, PASS if it answers every time.

script.name: t2_slow_connections
script.objective: [H2] Start service-go, open 50 connections and send nothing, wait 30 s. FAIL if it keeps all 50 open; then send one valid request, FAIL if it gets no answer within 5 s, PASS otherwise.

script.name: t3_egress
script.objective: [H3] Run tapi_egress while normal traffic goes to gateway-rs, service-go and service-cs; the allowed list is loopback only. FAIL on any connection to a non-loopback address, each destination is reported.

script.name: t4_csharp_backend_fail
script.objective: [H4] Start service-cs alone and make its backend call fail (hops=3 with gateway-rs down). FAIL if it returns 200 with an empty or default body, PASS if it returns 4xx or 5xx.

script.name: t5_go_contract
script.objective: [H5] Send service-go requests that break its contract: a missing field, a wrong type, a value out of range. FAIL if any answer is 2xx (or not 4xx), PASS if all are 4xx.

script.name: t6_binscan_netexpose
script.objective: [no hypothesis] tapi_binscan on gateway-rs, service-go, service-cs and the C, C++ and Python build outputs (NX, PIE, RELRO, canary, fortify per binary) and tapi_netexpose on the agent. Everything is reported as information in the tapi_cybersec_report; the test does not fail on it.

script.name: s_rust
script.objective: [smoke] Start gateway-rs and send one valid request. Checks that the process is still running (no exit code) and that the response is 2xx with a body carrying "value=". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_go
script.objective: [smoke] Start service-go and send one valid request. Checks that the process is still running (no exit code) and that the response is 2xx with a body carrying "value=". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_cs
script.objective: [smoke] Start service-cs and send one valid request. Checks that the process is still running (no exit code) and that the response is 2xx with a body carrying "value=". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_cpp
script.objective: [smoke] Run dist/bin/cpp-demo once with value=1 hops=1. Checks the exit code is 0 and the output carries "result =". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_c
script.objective: [smoke] dlopen dist/lib/libpycore.so (the C extension) and call its leaf C-ABI function py_weight() once in a child process. Checks the child's exit code is 0 and the value it printed is a finite number. Settles no hypothesis.
